edition_intro: You are not waiting for permission to build; you are looking for the right door. This edition rounds up scholarships, grants, conferences, competitions, and free certifications that are open right now or opening within the next two months, all vetted for real deadlines and zero application fees. Move fast, these windows close.

posts.title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/2028
posts.summary: Fully funded UK master's degree for future leaders, covering tuition, flights, and a monthly stipend at any UK university.
posts.eligibility: Nigerians with an undergraduate degree (UK 2:1 equivalent) and at least two years of work experience

posts.title: Rhodes Scholarship for West Africa 2027
posts.summary: The world's oldest international postgraduate scholarship, fully funding study at the University of Oxford plus a generous annual stipend.
posts.eligibility: Citizens of West African countries, including Nigeria, aged 18 to 27, with outstanding academic and leadership record

posts.title: Schwarzman Scholars, Class of 2027-2028
posts.summary: Fully funded one-year master's in global affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing, built to train the next generation of global leaders.
posts.eligibility: Bachelor's degree holders worldwide, generally aged 18 to 29, with demonstrated leadership potential; open to Nigerian applicants

posts.title: Draper Richards Kaplan Foundation Funding
posts.summary: Up to $300,000 in unrestricted funding over three years for early-stage, mission-driven ventures, including those based in Africa.
posts.eligibility: Early-stage for-profit or nonprofit organisations, roughly 2 to 5 years old, operating in Africa (among other regions), with a scalable social or environmental model

posts.title: IFC SME Growth Accelerator 2026
posts.summary: Up to $1.5 million in grant funding plus mentorship for high-growth small and medium enterprises across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
posts.eligibility: For-profit SMEs with 10 to 250 employees and verified annual revenue between $250,000 and $10 million, operating in eligible markets including Nigeria

posts.title: UNDP timbuktoo Launchpad
posts.summary: UNDP's pan-African venture-building programme funding and incubating startups across GreenTech, AgriTech, EdTech, CreativeTech, and MineTech.
posts.deadline: Rolling (quarterly cohorts; next intake begins September 2026)
posts.eligibility: Early-stage African startups building tech-enabled solutions in one of timbuktoo's focus sectors

posts.title: GITEX Nigeria 2026
posts.summary: West Africa's largest tech and startup expo, with free registration and a dedicated startup festival in Lagos.
posts.eligibility: Open to all: innovators, entrepreneurs, tech professionals, and students across Africa

posts.title: Nigeria Innovation Summit 2026 (NIS 11.0)
posts.summary: West Africa's biggest innovation gathering, free to attend, focused this year on building for the age of AI.
posts.eligibility: Open to innovators, startups, students, investors, and the wider innovation ecosystem

posts.title: MEST Africa Challenge 2026
posts.summary: A pan-African pitch competition offering $50,000 in equity investment to early-stage tech startups ready to scale.
posts.eligibility: Early-stage tech startups based in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Senegal, or South Africa

posts.title: Milken-Motsepe Prize in Circular Economy 2026
posts.summary: A $2 million global competition for African businesses building scalable circular economy solutions, with a $1 million grand prize.
posts.eligibility: Technology-driven companies in Africa reducing waste, extending material use, and building measurable environmental and economic impact

posts.title: PachiPanda Challenge Nigeria 2026
posts.summary: An MTN-backed environmental innovation challenge offering up to N10 million in prizes to young Nigerians solving pollution, climate, and conservation problems.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian residents aged 18 to 35, applying as individuals or teams of up to three, with early or idea-stage environmental solutions

posts.title: Google Africa Developer Scholarship (GADS) 2026
posts.summary: Free access to Google-backed technical training in Android, cloud, or mobile web development, with top performers winning full nanodegree scholarships.
posts.eligibility: African residents aged 18 and above interested in software development careers

posts.title: Digital Skills Nigeria: Free Microsoft Azure Certification Vouchers
posts.summary: A Federal Government and Microsoft partnership offering free courses and exam vouchers for Microsoft Azure and AI certifications.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian residents who register and complete a course on the platform

posts.title: AWS re/Start
posts.summary: A free, full-time 12-week cloud computing training programme preparing unemployed or underemployed Nigerians for entry-level cloud careers.
posts.eligibility: Unemployed or underemployed individuals in Nigeria; no prior technology background required

posts.title: Cisco Networking Academy
posts.summary: Free, self-paced courses and certification pathways in networking, cybersecurity, and Python, with no cost barrier to enrol.
posts.eligibility: Open globally to learners aged 13 and above, including all Nigerians
